name: max_parallel_workers_per_gather
description: Maximum number of parallel worker processes that a single Gather or Gather Merge node can request from the pool defined by max_worker_processes and bounded by max_parallel_workers.
symptoms: Underutilized CPU cores in analytical queries
Excessive memory consumption due to parallel worker overhead
Query plan fallback to serial execution (reduced throughput)
Resource contention leading to increased query latency

constraints.hard_rule: value <= min(max_worker_processes - 1, max_parallel_workers) and value <= num_cpu_cores

tuning_tips: Start with floor(num_cpu_cores / 2); reduce to 1–2 for OLTP workloads to avoid overhead; increase cautiously for analytical workloads, never exceeding available CPU cores. Always validate against actual parallel plan usage and memory pressure.
